findings.summary: Exception handling catches specific types only; other requests exceptions would not be caught
findings.suggestion: This follows the existing codebase pattern (see line 161-164 in client.py). If fetch_coverage() raises a requests exception not converted to ShopSpendTransientError (e.g., TooManyRedirects), it will bubble up uncaught. Consider documenting this design choice or adding catch-all exception handling if robustness is desired, but current approach is consistent with existing code style and passes all tests.
